name: Hootbeast
description: The hootbeast blends the features of an owl and a bear, creating a fearsome creature of the night with feathers shift colors to blend in with their surroundings. With its sharp beak and powerful talons, it is an apex predator known for it's curious resistance to magical effects.

actions.name: Razor Talons
actions.description: The hootbeast makes an attack with it's sharp talons, dealing physical damage. In the event of a true hit, the target gains the bleeding condition of they take damage after mitigations.

actions.name: Flurry
actions.description: The hootbeast makes quick, aggressive attacks with little regard for it's own safety. Until the start of it's next turn, the hootbeast gains a 1d4 bonus to all attack checks and a 1d4 penalty to defense checks.

actions.name: Razor Beak
actions.description: The hootbeast slices into a creature with it's sharp beak, dealing physical damage. In the event of a true hit, the target gains one tier of the wounded condition if they take damage after mitigation.

actions.name: Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving the hootbeast's area of control, it makes an attack against them.

traits.name: Adaptive Plumage
traits.description: The hootbeast has the ability to change the shade of it's feathers, which typically getting much darker by nightfall.  During this time, the hootbeast has a 1d4 bonus to stealth checks in darkness or under the night sky.
